assistant_content: Deep learning refers to a subset of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks with multiple hidden layers, whereas traditional machine learning algorithms rely on explicit programming of rules or predefined data for model training. Deep learning excels in handling complex, real-world data such as images and audio, while traditional machine learning approaches tend to excel with structured data like labeled datasets and performance on standard testing metrics.
